newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB says financial services sales up 28 pct.
newsitem.headline: NAB says financial services sales up 28 pct.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd said on Wednesday that its sales of financial services products rose 28 percent in the half year to March 31 to A$1.35 billion compared with a year earlier.
Sales in the half year to September 1996 had totalled A$1.56 billion refecting a seasonal sales peak prior to the end of the tax year, NAB said.

Sales growth was achieved across the key areas of insurance, supperannuation and unit trusts, NAB said. New regular premium business was up by 45 percent, while corporate superannuation sales rose 50 percent for regular premium business and 275 percent for single premiums.
The increase in total sales was assisted by a large increase in sales of wholesale funds to A$220.5 million from A$79.1 million the previous year. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373 1800
